job.title: Tax Advisory Senior
job.description:
Tax Advisory Senior
Belfast | Full-Time Permanent | Tax Advisory & M&A

Amplifi Talent are partnering with an accountancy and advisory firm to appoint a Tax Advisory Senior to join its Belfast team.

This represents an opportunity for a qualified tax professional with mixed tax and M&A experience to contribute to a varied portfolio of advisory work.

The successful candidate will support the delivery and implementation of corporate tax planning and M&A transactions, with involvement in estate planning depending on experience.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:

  • Support the delivery and implementation of corporate tax planning
  • Contribute to M&A transactions
  • Assist with estate planning and implementation, depending on experience
  • Identify tax planning opportunities for clients
  • Communicate with HMRC as required
  • Collaborate with tax and accounting colleagues to coordinate advisory and compliance work

The role would suit a technically strong tax professional who enjoys working collaboratively on planning and transaction-related matters.

The Person

Key skills and experience are likely to include:
  • CTA qualification
  • At least three years’ post-qualification experience in a mixed tax role within a mid-tier firm
  • Experience of M&A work
  • A proven ability to work with other technical professionals
  • Strong organisational skills, accuracy and attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal and Excel skills
  • The ability to summarise technical information clearly and concisely

The successful candidate will combine technical capability with a practical approach to delivering advice and maintaining effective professional relationships.

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:
  • mixed tax teams within mid-tier accountancy firms
  • tax advisory practices
  • corporate tax planning and transaction advisory teams

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.

job.title: Senior Accountant / Assistant Manager
job.description:
Senior Accountant / Assistant Manager
Belfast | Full-Time Permanent | Accounts & Advisory

Amplifi Talent are partnering with an accountancy and advisory firm to appoint a Senior Accountant or Assistant Manager to join its Belfast team.

This is an opportunity for a qualified accountant to take on a varied role combining year-end accounts, client relationships and the development of junior colleagues.

The successful candidate will also have involvement in project work, including client transactions, mergers and acquisitions, and raising finance, while supporting the organisation of team workloads.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:·      

  • Prepare and supervise year-end accounts for limited companies, sole traders and partnerships
  • Prepare associated tax computations and returns, with prior tax experience not mandatory
  • Contribute to projects involving client transactions, M&A and raising finance
  • Train, oversee and mentor junior team members
  • Assist management with organising and prioritising team workflow
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients

The appointment offers scope to combine hands-on technical delivery with team responsibility, with the level of appointment reflecting relevant experience.

The Person

Key skills and experience are likely to include:

  • ACA or ACCA qualification
  • At least one year’s post-qualification experience in accountancy practice for the Senior Accountant role
  • At least two years’ post-qualification experience in accountancy practice for the Assistant Manager role
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience using Xero, QuickBooks or similar cloud accounting software
  • Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and WordPrevious audit experience would be advantageous.

The role would suit somebody who enjoys varied client work and supporting the development of colleagues.

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:
  • accounts and business services teams
  • general practice accountancy firms
  • client accounting and advisory teams

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.

job.title: Audit Manager
job.description:
Audit Manager
Belfast | Full-Time Permanent | Audit & Assurance

Amplifi Talent are partnering with an accountancy and advisory firm to appoint an Audit Manager to join its Belfast team.

This is an opportunity for an experienced audit professional to lead engagements across a range of clients and sectors, combining technical oversight with client relationship management and team development.

The successful candidate will manage audit planning and delivery, review the work of colleagues and contribute to wider advisory projects and improvements within the audit function.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:
  • Lead audit engagements across a varied client portfolio
  • Plan assignments, identify key risks and ensure compliance with auditing standards
  • Review audit files, financial statements and supporting documentation
  • Supervise, train and review the work of audit staff
  • Act as a key client contact throughout the audit process
  • Support workflow planning, team organisation and continuous improvement
  • Contribute to internal controls reviews, due diligence and technical accounting projects

The role would suit somebody who enjoys taking ownership of audit delivery while building strong client relationships and developing the capability of their team.

The Person

Key skills and experience are likely to include:

  • ACA or ACCA qualification
  • At least five years’ post-qualification audit experience within accountancy practice
  • Strong knowledge of auditing standards and financial reporting frameworks, including FRS 102
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience using MyWorkPapers or similar audit software
  • Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Excel and Word
  • The ability to manage deadlines, prioritise workloads and work effectively within a team
  • Knowledge of IFRS would be advantageous.

The successful candidate will bring sound technical judgement and a clear, organised approach to managing engagements.

The role may suit candidates currently operating within:
  • audit and assurance teams within accountancy practice
  • audit management roles in professional services
  • senior audit positions with engagement and team leadership responsibility

For further information, please contact Billy McCarthy, Amplifi Talent, in confidence.
